ig4.hint: Steps: 1) pick the dataset type (style/character) and, if style, set art_style above  2) double-click an image to draw boxes  3) press Start to capture and export.
ig4.no_jobs: Draw boxes on at least one image first (double-click).
ig4.is_character: Character dataset — the VLM infers each image's style
ig4.tip.is_character: Style = one global art_style for the whole set (best for a consistent style LoRA). Character = the subject appears in many styles, so the VLM infers the style of each image individually.
ig4.infer_style: Infer the global style with the VLM
ig4.canvas_help: Drag on the image to draw a box. Click a box to select it, then drag its corners to resize or its body to move it. Only the selected box moves. Wheel = zoom, middle-button drag = pan. Arrow keys move the box (Shift = 10 px); Ctrl+D duplicates it.
ig4.tip.canvas: Drawing area. Empty space = draw a new box; on a box = select/move/resize. Wheel = zoom, middle-button drag = pan.
ig4.tip.type_obj: Object: a visual element (character, prop, panel, frame). On Start the VLM describes it and k-means extracts its colors.
ig4.tip.type_text: Text: literal words in the image (titles, dialog). You type the exact string; it is ground truth and never sent to the VLM.
ig4.tip.list: Every box you draw. Order = prominence: #1 is the most salient. Drag rows to reorder — it matters for the caption. Text boxes are moved to the end automatically on export.
ig4.tip.delete: Remove the selected box from the list and the image.
ig4.tip.elem_text: The exact words shown in this text box (ground truth). Enabled only for 'text' elements.
ig4.tip.elem_desc: Short description of this element. For objects the VLM fills it on Start if empty; anything you write here is kept (not overwritten).
ig4.tip.compose_text: Render NEW text onto the image (titles, flyers), optionally inside a speech bubble. The box and color become ground truth. Select a 'text' element first.
ig4.tip.compose_shape: Draw a frame, panel or speech-bubble shape onto the image. Select an 'object' element first.
ig4.tip.hld: One or two sentences describing the whole scene. The VLM fills this on Start if you leave it empty.
ig4.tip.background: Describes ONLY the background. The VLM fills this on Start if empty.
ig4.tip.aesthetics: Optional. Mood/aesthetics of the set's style (e.g. 'clean studio').
ig4.tip.lighting: Optional. Lighting of the set's style (e.g. 'soft key light').
ig4.tip.art_style: REQUIRED to export. This image's art style. In a style dataset it is inherited from the panel (keep it identical across the set); in a character dataset the VLM fills it per image on Start if you leave it empty.
ig4.tip.save: Save boxes and fields to the work file (.pano.json) and close the editor. You can reopen and continue later; capture (Start) reads these files.
ig4.tip.align: Snap the text block to this position on the image (fine-tune with x / y).
ig4.tip.close: Close the editor discarding unsaved changes since the last save.
ig4.tip.set_artstyle: REQUIRED in Style mode. The art style shared by the whole set. Write it once; it is inherited by every image. Keep it identical so the LoRA learns a single consistent style. (Or leave it to the VLM with 'Infer the global style'.)
ig4.tip.set_aesthetics: Optional. Shared mood/aesthetics (e.g. 'clean studio, soft palette').
ig4.tip.set_lighting: Optional. Shared lighting (e.g. 'soft three-point key light').
ig4.tip.padding: Extra margin added around each object box before it is cropped and sent to the VLM. More padding = more surrounding context, but less isolation.
ig4.tip.prompt_hld: Instruction sent to the VLM to describe the whole image (high_level_description). Edit only if you know what you want.
ig4.tip.prompt_bg: Instruction sent to the VLM to describe only the background.
ig4.tip.prompt_obj: Instruction sent to the VLM for each object crop (its 'desc'). Applied per object box.
ig4.tip.prompt_style: Used whenever the VLM infers the style (character dataset, or style dataset with 'Infer the global style'). Asks the VLM for art_style/aesthetics/lighting; the reply is parsed into those fields.
ig4.tip.infer_style: Style mode only. OFF: you type art_style by hand. ON: the VLM reads one image, derives art_style/aesthetics/lighting and reuses the SAME style for the whole set — still consistent, just automatic.
ig4.tip.recapture: OFF (resume): only empty fields are captured, so re-running is cheap and won't re-spend the VLM. ON: re-asks the VLM and overwrites everything already captured.
ig4.artstyle_missing_msg: {0} image(s) have no art_style and cannot be exported (it is required). Fill art_style in the panel before drawing, or in each box editor, enable 'Infer the global style', or switch to a character dataset. Continue and skip them?
ig4.tip.tx_text: The exact words to render (this becomes the element's ground-truth text).
ig4.tip.tx_font: Typeface. Bundled OFL/Apache fonts — same look on any machine.
ig4.tip.tx_effect: Layout style: straight, arc, wave, circle, perspective, tilt or vertical.
ig4.tip.tx_strength: Intensity of the chosen effect (curvature/amplitude/angle). Disabled for Straight and Vertical.
ig4.tip.tx_stroke: Outline thickness around the glyphs (0 = none). Helps readability over busy images.
ig4.tip.tx_pos: Top-left X position of the text block, in pixels.
ig4.tip.tx_pos_y: Top-left Y position of the text block, in pixels.
ig4.tip.tx_color: Glyph color. Saved as the element's ground-truth color (#RRGGBB).
ig4.tip.tx_frame: Optional shape drawn BEHIND the text (speech bubble for dialog). It auto-wraps the text.
ig4.tip.tx_frame_fill: Fill the frame with a solid color so the text reads on top (on by default for bubbles).
ig4.tip.tx_apply: Bake the text (and frame) onto the output copy and return. The box is computed automatically.
ig4.tip.sh_shape: Frame type: rectangle, rounded rectangle, ellipse, or speech bubble (with tail).
ig4.tip.sh_x: Top-left X of the shape, in pixels.
ig4.tip.sh_y: Top-left Y of the shape, in pixels.
ig4.tip.sh_radius: Corner roundness (rounded rectangle and bubble only).
ig4.tip.sh_tail_x: Speech-bubble tail tip X — point it toward the speaker (bubble only).
ig4.tip.sh_fill: Fill the shape with a solid color (e.g. white bubble so text reads).
ig4.tip.sh_fill_color: Fill color (used when Fill is on).
ig4.tip.sh_apply: Bake the shape onto the output copy and return. The box is computed automatically.
ig4.tip.zoom_fit: Fit the whole image in the view
ig4.auto_none: No objects detected. Draw the boxes by hand.
ig4.tip.auto_detect: Detect characters, animals and objects with YOLO and add them as boxes (type 'object', no description: the VLM captures it on Start). Review and adjust them: resize, add missing ones, or delete extras. Text is still drawn by hand.
ig4.tip.batch_detect: Run YOLO over every image in the set and save a draft .pano.json with detected objects (no description: the VLM captures it on Start). Images that already have boxes are left untouched. Then double-click each image to review and adjust.
ig4.tip.text_color: Current text color (ground truth). Click to pick it by hand.
ig4.tip.eyedropper: Sample the EXACT color of existing text: click here, then click the glyph on the image. The sampled hex becomes this text's color.
ig4.tip.prev: Save and go to the previous image (Alt+←).
ig4.tip.next: Save and go to the next image (Alt+→).
cherry.delete_profile_tip: Removes it from the index. The downloaded folder is left untouched.
cherry.settings_workers_tip: Default only: each site's template caps it, and the download view can ask for a different number.
cherry.settings_daily_limit_tip: Combined total across all servers. Files already downloading finish, so the final total may be slightly higher.
cherry.settings_pawchive_tip: Pawchive only. It pauses at whichever happens first: the file count or transferred GB. Its combined bandwidth remains capped at 2 MB/s.
cherry.settings_pawchive_recommended: Recommended default: 500 downloads or 25 GB / 3 hours · fixed 2 MB/s shared by Pawchive workers · resumes after 50 slots.
cherry.settings_pawchive_headroom_tip: After the file limit is reached, Pawchive waits until this many real slots have expired before resuming. Set zero to resume one file at a time as before.
cherry.settings_note: Changing the download folder does not move anything: existing projects keep the path they were created with, and only new ones land here. Saved to {file}, shared with the standalone cherry-dl.
cherry.settings_dir_empty: The download folder cannot be empty.
cherry.settings_dir_missing: “{f}” does not exist. Create it first, or pick another one.
cherry.dups_intro: Two projects sharing a source are the same artist added twice — that one is a certainty, not a guess. A similar name is only a suspicion. Merging is not done here: it moves files between folders on disk.
cherry.dups_not_same_tip: The pair stops showing up, here and in cherry-dl.
cherry.dups_source_tip: Both projects download the same artist from the same site.
cherry.dups_none: No suspicious pairs. {n} pairs are already marked as different.
cherry.dups_found: {n} pairs to review · {e} already marked as different.
cherry.dups_excluded: Marked as different. {n} pairs left to review.
cherry.dups_merge_tip: Turns the two projects into one: the older keeps its folder and receives what the other has and it lacks. Shows the numbers before moving anything — but once confirmed there is no undo.
cherry.dups_close_tip: Closes the list. Nothing is left running.
cherry.merge_why_keep: The older project is the one that stays — cherry-dl decides that, it is not a choice. Its folder is the one that keeps growing.
cherry.merge_paths_tip: Top: the folder that receives the files. Bottom: the one left behind.
cherry.merge_n_move_tip: Unique to the project being absorbed: nothing in the destination has the same content.
cherry.merge_n_dup_tip: Same content, byte for byte. They do not move — you choose below what happens to them.
cherry.merge_n_missing_tip: The catalogue mentions them but the file is gone. They are skipped.
cherry.merge_n_untracked_tip: Files sitting in the folder that cherry-dl never registered. Nothing moves or deletes them: they stay where they are, even if the folder is emptied.
cherry.merge_orphan_q: What to do with the {n} already in the destination:
cherry.merge_orphan_keep_tip: Nothing is deleted. The folder stays with its copies — the safe choice if you want to check the result first.
cherry.merge_orphan_rename_tip: Marks the leftover folder without deleting anything, so it is easy to find and remove later.
cherry.merge_orphan_delete_tip: Deletes the copies for good — not to the recycle bin. The folder itself goes too if nothing else is left in it.
cherry.merge_warn: ⚠ Merging moves files on disk and cannot be undone.
cherry.merge_unreadable: ⚠ The catalogue of the project to absorb could not be read. Nothing will be merged.
cherry.merge_go_tip: Moves the files and merges the two projects into one. No undo.
cherry.merge_done: ✓ Merged into {keep} · {moved} files moved, {dup} were already there.
cherry.merge_failed: Merge stopped and nothing was merged — both projects are intact. {msg}
cherry.archive_detail: ◷ Pawchive: {n} originals announced but not archived yet
cherry.archive_marker_tip: {n} Pawchive originals are announced but not archived yet.
cherry.archive_check_tip: Rechecks up to 25 originals whose post says Pawchive has not archived them yet. They stay outside the active queue meanwhile.
cherry.archive_prepare_failed: Could not prepare the Pawchive check.
cherry.detail_gone: Profile no longer in the index.
cherry.no_index: No index found at ~/.cherry-dl/index.db — create a project with New project.
cherry.runtime_failed: Could not start the async runtime.
cherry.ext_custom_tip: Extra extensions on top of the boxes above, comma separated.
cherry.ext_hint_none: Select a project to choose its file types.
cherry.ext_hint_all: Nothing selected: every file type is downloaded.
cherry.ext_apply_all_tip: Copy these types to every project currently listed.
cherry.ext_apply_all_body: {n} listed projects will download only these {e} extensions. Their current selection is replaced.
cherry.ext_apply_all_body_none: {n} listed projects will go back to downloading every file type. Their current selection is replaced.
cherry.ext_applied_all: File types applied to the listed projects.
cherry.scan_tip: Look for new files and queue them, without downloading.
cherry.batch_body: {n} profiles will be synced in global passes: paid official sites first, then free official sites and repositories. It can take hours and can be cancelled at any point.
cherry.dl_pawchive_quota: Pawchive · {remaining:.3f} GB remaining of {limit:g} · {files} files remaining of {file_limit} · {hours:g} h rolling window · next release: {release}{recovery}{active}
cherry.dl_pawchive_quota_tip: Pawchive only. Completed files come from the persistent rolling window; bytes still downloading are provisional and are committed only when the transfer finishes.
cherry.dl_follow_events_tip: Keep the newest event visible. Turn it off to inspect earlier lines while downloads continue.
cherry.auth_body:
{site} needs an active session. Without one, only free public posts would be downloaded.

Log in now? Your real browser will open so you can sign in; the download resumes by itself afterwards.
cherry.auth_pixiv_body:
Pixiv needs an active session with explicit content enabled. Your browser will open the login or display settings as needed; the scan resumes by itself afterwards.

Continue?
cherry.remove_url_tip: Removes the selected source and its queued downloads. Files already downloaded remain in the project.
cherry.remove_url_detail:
{url}

Its queued downloads and sync state will be removed. Files already downloaded and catalogued stay untouched.
cherry.new_resolve_failed: Could not fetch the name ({msg}) — type it by hand and create anyway.
cherry.add_url_hint: Everything lands in the same folder as the profile. Its first sync scans the whole history of the new source.
cherry.dup_url: ⚠ This URL is already a source of: {names}
cherry.known_artist: ℹ The library already has {n} files by “{a}” in {w}.
lib.backfill_tip: Compute the SHA-256 content identity of files that lack it (cherry-dl folders get theirs from catalog.db). Resumable.
settings.back_tip: Back to the dashboard. Nothing in progress is cancelled and the tool keeps its state.
cherry.new_profile_tip: Registers a project and runs its initial scan. Downloads nothing until you start it.
cherry.search_ph_tip: Filters the list by project name or by its folder on disk. Does not search inside files.
cherry.site_filter_tip: Shows only the projects from one site (Patreon, Pixiv…).
cherry.only_missing_tip: Leaves only the projects whose folder is gone from disk — typical after moving files or unplugging a drive.
cherry.download_all_tip: Downloads EVERY listed project in global source passes: paid official sites first, then free official sites and repositories. It honours each project's filter and can be cancelled at any point.
cherry.dups_open_tip: Looks for projects pointing at the same source or with near-identical names. It only reports: it deletes and merges nothing.
cherry.settings_open_tip: Download folder, parallel workers, timeout and Pawchive's safety window.
cherry.refresh_tip: Re-reads the index from disk. Useful if another program touched the projects.
cherry.add_url_tip: Adds another source URL to the selected project. One project can gather several sources into a single folder.
cherry.dl_workers_tip: How many files download at once. Each site has its own cap and the engine trims this number if you go over.
cherry.dl_rescan_tip: Goes through the whole project instead of resuming from the last sync. Much slower; use it when you suspect something old is missing.
cherry.download_tip: Downloads the new files of the selected project. When it finishes it tells the library to index them.
cherry.open_folder_tip: Opens the project's download folder in the file explorer.
cherry.cancel_tip: Stops the running download and the rest of the queue. Whatever already downloaded is kept.
pickler.open_folder_tip: Choose the folder of images to review. It is walked in order and nothing is changed until you decide on each image.
pickler.mode_tip: Switches the working MODE, it does not act on the current image. In «Keep» the big button keeps the image; in «Discard» it discards it. This is the top button: the bottom one is the one that acts.
pickler.choose_dest_tip: Folder where the images you keep end up. Discards do NOT go here: they go to «discarded» inside the source folder.
pickler.move_tip: The images you keep are MOVED to the destination: they leave the source folder.
pickler.copy_tip: The images you keep are COPIED to the destination: the original stays where it is.
pickler.undo_tip: Undoes ONLY the last decision and puts the image back. It is not a history: it does not chain several steps back.
pickler.open_dest_tip: Opens the folder where the images you keep are saved.
pickler.open_discarded_tip: Opens the source's «discarded» folder, where the discarded images are. They are still there: nothing was really deleted.
pickler.action_tip: Applies the current mode to the image on screen and moves to the next one. Discarding does NOT delete: it moves the file to «discarded», and it can be undone.
pickler.action_skip_tip: Moves to the next image without touching it or deciding anything about it.
wm.load_image_tip: Loads the image to stamp onto. The original file is never touched: the result is saved as a separate copy.
wm.load_wm_tip: Image tiled across the whole photo. Use a PNG with transparency so the background shows through.
wm.load_logo_tip: Image placed ONCE in a corner, on top of the tiled pattern. They are separate things: you can use just one of them.
wm.angle_tip: Tilt of the tiled pattern. A diagonal one is harder to crop out than a horizontal one.
wm.scale_tip: Size of each tile, from 10% to 200%. Bigger means fewer tiles, further apart.
wm.opacity_tip: How transparent the pattern is, from 0 to 100%. Under 20% it barely gets in the way, but it is also easier to remove.
wm.logo_pos_tip: Corner where the logo is placed.
wm.logo_size_tip: Logo width in pixels, from 50 to 500. It is a fixed size: it does not scale with the image, so on a small photo it looks proportionally bigger.
wm.save_copy_tip: Saves a copy with the mark applied. NOTE: it deliberately strips ALL metadata from the result (prompts, tags, EXIF), because these copies are meant for publishing. The original keeps its own.
tagger.browse_tip: Folder of images to caption. Captions are written as .txt files next to each image.
tagger.mode_tip: Which caption format is produced. «Both» yields TWO separate datasets, not one mixed text; «Ideogram v4» produces structured JSON and enables its own panel.
tagger.model_tags_tip: Instruction template for tags. It changes the prompt below: a starting point you can edit.
tagger.engine_tip: Who generates the tags. The WD tagger runs on your machine and gives real booru tags; the vision LLM makes them up from the image and depends on the endpoint.
tagger.wd_tagger_tip: Which WD model to use. Confidence thresholds are set by the preset and not exposed here: they are calibrated to prioritise the character.
tagger.wd_download_tip: Downloads the selected WD model if it is not on disk yet. It is several hundred MB and only needed once.
tagger.model_natural_tip: Instruction template for the natural-language text. It changes the prompt below, which you can edit.
tagger.endpoint_tip: Address of your local OpenAI-compatible server (LM Studio, Ollama…). Nothing is sent to the internet.
tagger.apikey_tip: Only if your server requires one. Most local servers do not need it.
tagger.discover_tip: Scans the usual ports on your machine for compatible servers and fills the address in for you.
tagger.test_tip: Checks that the address responds and fetches the list of models it offers, so you can pick one below.
tagger.endpoint_model_tip: The actual model that will serve the requests. It must be a vision model: if it is not, a warning appears just below.
tagger.trigger_tip: Unique word placed first in every caption, the one that will later trigger your LoRA. Best if it means nothing in English.
tagger.prefix_tip: Fixed text prepended to every caption, after the trigger word.
tagger.suffix_tip: Fixed text appended to the end of every caption.
tagger.policy_tip: What to do with images that ALREADY have a .txt: skip them, overwrite them or append. This is the difference between finishing a half-done folder and redoing it whole.
tagger.recursive_tip: Also walks into subfolders. On large folders it multiplies the work and the time.
tagger.reset_tags_tip: Resets THIS prompt (the tags one) to the chosen template's default text. Whatever you typed here is lost; the other prompt is untouched.
tagger.reset_natural_tip: Resets THIS prompt (the natural-language one) to the chosen template's default text. Whatever you typed here is lost; the other prompt is untouched.
tagger.review_tip: Opens the captions already generated to read and fix them by hand, image by image. It generates nothing new.
tagger.run_tip: Starts generating captions for the whole folder. It can take a long time: it goes image by image against the model.
tagger.cancel_tip: Stops the run. The captions already written stay on disk.
tagger.content_nsfw_tip: Adds a modifier to the prompt so the model describes explicit content without censoring itself. You will see it appear in the prompt editor below. The WD tagger ignores it: it already gives NSFW tags out of the box.
lib.add_tip: Registers a folder to watch. It copies nothing: it only notes where to look when indexing.
lib.remove_tip: Stops watching the folder and drops its files from the index. The files on disk are NOT touched.
lib.search_tip: Searches by name, tags and metadata text across the whole indexed library, not just the open folder.
lib.selection_action_tip: Which tool to send the selected images to. Pick here and press Execute.
lib.execute_tip: Sends every match (up to 1,000); larger sets require choosing the current page. No partial set is sent as complete.
lib.purge_tip: Goes through the index and drops entries whose file is gone from disk. Useful after deleting or moving things outside the app. It deletes no files.
lib.run_indexer_tip: Walks the watched folders and adds whatever is new to the library. On a large library it takes a while; the same button stops it.
cr.load_folder_tip: Folder of images to look for known faces in.
cr.mode_illustration_tip: Mode for drawings and anime. Uses a detector trained on illustrated faces; it does worse on real photos.
cr.mode_real_tip: Mode for photography. Uses a detector trained on real faces; it does worse on drawings.
cr.auto_scan_tip: Goes through the whole folder recognising faces without asking one by one, then shows what it found for you to confirm.
cr.btn_yes_tip: Confirms the face is who it suggests and saves the tag. Shortcut: Enter.
cr.btn_manual_tip: Rejects the suggestion and lets you type the name by hand. Shortcut: Esc.
cr.btn_skip_tip: Moves to the next face without tagging this one.
cr.btn_return_tip: Back to the previous recognition screen.
cr.btn_save_tip: Saves the typed name and links it to this face.
cr.combo_names_tip: Characters already known. Pick one instead of typing it to avoid duplicates from a typo.
cr.btn_remove_tag_tip: Removes this tag from the image. The file itself is untouched.
cr.tag_all_tip: Applies the suggested name to every indexed image in the scanned batch, including images without a match. Stops on error; retry keeps confirmed tags.
cr.auto_cancel_tip: Stops the automatic scan. Whatever was tagged so far is kept.
cr.btn_back_tip: Goes back without saving the typed name.
crop.ar_tip: Locks the crop ratio. «Free» lets you drag as you like; the rest keep the shape fixed while you adjust.
crop.size_tip: Exact crop size in pixels. With a fixed ratio, changing one recomputes the other.
crop.save_tip: Saves the crop as a new file. The original is left alone, and its metadata is copied over to the crop.
fscanner.select_tip: Folder to analyse. It only counts formats and sizes to give you a report: it converts and touches nothing.
dup.mode_tip: Exact modes verify current bytes and complete curation. Visual similarity may reuse proven cache after current SHA. Folder overlap only classifies stored-hash sets. Saving pHash is a separate explicit folder phase; similarity never authorizes retirement.
dup.threshold_tip: Maximum pHash distance; smaller values require closer similarity. Similarity never authorizes retirement.
dup.select_folder_tip: Choose the folder whose current files will be compared.
dup.run_scan_tip: Read current files and documented states. No database records or file bytes are changed by scanning.
dup.auto_select_tip: Only marks exact copies whose complete information is preserved in the retained copy. Never selects the first file by position.
dup.delete_tip: Rechecks every current member and its complete state, archives selected IDs and moves their bytes to recovery. Keeps the curated copy and Cherry receipts; the destination must be outside all source folders.
opt.format_tip: Output format. WebP and AVIF weigh far less than JPEG at the same apparent quality, but not every program opens them.
opt.resize_tip: Whether to also shrink the pixel size on top of recompressing.
opt.max_side_tip: Limit for the longest side, in pixels. The aspect ratio is kept and images already smaller are not enlarged.
opt.preserve_meta_tip: Copies the original's prompts and generation data to the result. Without it, the optimised copy loses the image's «recipe».
opt.load_images_tip: Adds images to the queue. The originals are not modified: the result goes to a separate folder.
opt.analyze_tip: Looks at the queued images and suggests a format and size, without converting anything yet.
opt.process_tip: Converts the whole queue with the settings above and opens the result folder when it finishes.
meta.viewer_tip: Read-only: shows the prompts and generation data without letting you change them.
meta.editor_tip: Lets you edit the prompts. This is the only module that can write over the original file — that is what it is for.
meta.save_tip: OVERWRITES the original file with your edits. It asks for confirmation, and warns separately if you are about to leave it with no metadata: that erases the «recipe» and cannot be undone.
meta.export_tip: Saves a NEW file with the edited metadata and leaves the original untouched. It is the safe option next to «Save changes».
meta.open_tip: Loads one or more images to view or edit their metadata.
meta.prev_tip: Previous of the loaded images. Unsaved changes are lost.
meta.next_tip: Next of the loaded images. Unsaved changes are lost.
fc.select_folder_tip: Converts every image in a folder.
fc.add_files_tip: Adds individual files to the queue, on top of the folder or instead of it.
fc.recursive_tip: Also walks into the subfolders of the chosen folder.
fc.format_tip: Format to convert to. The originals are untouched: the result goes to a separate folder.
fc.preserve_meta_tip: Copies the original's prompts and generation data to the converted file. Without it they are lost in the conversion.
fc.verify_tip: After converting, re-reads each file and checks the metadata really made it. It is slower, but on large batches it is what stops you finding out too late.
fc.clear_queue_tip: Empties the list of manually added files. It deletes nothing from disk.
fc.convert_tip: Converts everything in the queue and opens the result folder when it finishes.
gallery.open_folder_tip: Opens a folder of images to browse here.
gallery.back_albums_tip: Back to the album view, leaving this folder's contents.
gallery.search_tip: Filters by tags or metadata text. Type several tags to keep only the images that have them all. Put metadata text in double quotes; separate entries with commas.
gallery.rating_tip: Leaves only the images with that rating or better.
gallery.clear_filters_tip: Clears the search and the rating at once, showing everything again.
gallery.picker_tip: Turns on multi-select so you can send several images to another tool. NOTE: turning it off clears whatever you had selected.
gallery.send_tip: Sends the selected images to another tool. Opens a menu to pick which one.
cherry.dl_site_blocked_log: ⛔ {site} refused {n} downloads in a row. The site is abandoned for this run; the files stay queued for another day.
cherry.archives_process_tip: Only this project: organizes files, extracts ZIP/RAR, keeps the lowest-numbered copy of each exact hash and compacts every file counter. Unavailable during downloads.
cherry.archives_all_tip: Runs the same organize, extract, exact-hash deduplicate and counter-compaction operation for every visible project, in the table order.
cherry.archives_batch_body: {n} visible projects will be processed in table order. ZIP/RAR files will be extracted, exact duplicates will keep the lowest number and each file counter will be compacted. Every project keeps a recovery plan and catalog backup. Continue?
cherry.archives_cancelled: Cancelled. Run the action again to resume.
cherry.archives_done: Archives: {p} processed, {a} files added, {d} archive duplicates; maintenance: {r} exact copies removed, {c} renumbered, {u} recovered; {o} organized, {e} errors.
gallery.db.read_error: Could not load library. Change the view or filters to retry.
gallery.db.title: Library
gallery.db.write_error: Could not save rating. Reloading confirmed data.
gallery.db.tags_error: Tag suggestions could not be loaded; search is still available.
gallery.viewer.curation_tip: Curation is saved in the library; original files are preserved.
gallery.viewer.unregistered: This image is not registered in the library; curation is read only.
tool.image_optimizer.data_error:
Library data could not be read: {reason}
Processed: {processed}. The remaining images stay in the queue.
tool.cropper.source_destination: Choose a different destination: the source image must be preserved.
tool.character_recognizer.unregistered: Index this image in Librarian before editing its tags.
tool.character_recognizer.bulk_error: Stopped after {done} confirmed images: {reason}. Retry continues with the remaining images.
tool.character_recognizer.tags_tip: Tags confirmed by the library. Select one to remove it without changing the image.
tool.character_recognizer.retry_tags_tip: Retries the library read for this image after an error.
tool.character_recognizer.reload_profile: Refreshes known names after a profile read error; keeps the name being typed.
tool.character_recognizer.reference_erro: Tag saved, but reference failed: {reason}. Retry Save to learn it.
lib.review_tip: Select a folder and clear tag filters. Compare its exported curation with the central database in pages; conflicts retain both values. No changes are applied.
lib.review.title: Review folder curation
lib.review.note: Comparison does not apply curation. Explicitly choose the export to replace curation, register an absent copy or complete its unknown central identity. Each page reflects the central database when it is read.
lib.review.table_tip: Select a copy to compare its exported and current tags, sources, ratings and hashes.
lib.review.details_tip: Plain text preview limited to 16,384 characters per state. Use the compare command for the full record if this preview is incomplete.
lib.review.restart_tip: Read the current export again from its first page; discard this traversal.
lib.review.next_tip: Compare up to 100 more copies without keeping earlier pages in memory.
lib.review.close_tip: Close this review. An explicitly accepted restoration continues in the database service.
lib.review.error: Comparison stopped: {reason}. Restart to read the current export.
lib.review.page: Compared {seen} of {total} copies. Earlier pages are not retained.
lib.review.absent: No registered copy at this path.
lib.review.truncated: Incomplete preview; total tags: {count}. Use compare for the full record.
lib.review.error.sidecar_changed: The export changed during this review
lib.review.error.sidecar_count_mismatch: The declared copy count does not match the available records
lib.review.error.sidecar_payload_too_lar: One copy contains more tag data than the comparison can read
lib.review.register_tip: Explicitly register only this absent path or complete both missing hashes and restore its exported curation. Verifies current bytes first; keeps other copies and rejects concurrent changes.
lib.review.error.file_now_registered: This path was registered after the review; restart to compare its curation
lib.review.error.identity_already_known: The copy already has a known identity; restart the review
lib.review.error.invalid_curation_observ: The current file observations cannot be registered
lib.review.apply_tip: Replace only this registered copy’s tags, sources and rating with its exported values. Requires known identity and complete previews; verifies file bytes in a worker and rejects changes since review.
lib.review.restore_error: Could not restore {path}: {reason}. Restart the review if the state changed.
lib.review.restored: Restored exported curation for {path}. Review restarted.
lib.review.error.curation_changed_since_: The current curation changed since this page was read
lib.review.error.tag_category_conflict: An existing shared tag has a different category
lib.review.error.curation_hash_mismatch: The file bytes do not match the exported identity
lib.review.error.curation_file_symlink: This file is a symbolic link and requires separate review
lib.review.error.identity_changed: The registered identity differs from the export
lib.review.error.identity_missing: This copy has no known identity
lib.review.error.restore_payload_too_lar: This copy has too many tags to restore
lib.review.error.invalid_restore_tag: A tag cannot be restored without changing its format
lib.recovery.open_tip: Choose any folder, including one not indexed. Inspect interrupted export resources, then explicitly quarantine verified resources without touching its images or catalogs.
lib.recovery.title: Recover interrupted export
lib.recovery.note: Inspection only reads resources. Quarantine moves exactly the listed temporary files and lock into a new recovery folder with a saved plan. Images, Cherry catalogs and the published export stay in place.
lib.recovery.table_tip: Complete list from the export manifest, including its lock and existing temporary journals. No unclaimed files are moved.
lib.recovery.inspect_tip: Read current resources again and discard the previous fingerprint; does not move or delete files.
lib.recovery.quarantine_tip: Revalidate the shown fingerprint under the export guard and move only the listed resources. Keeps their bytes and a recovery plan; never promotes a temporary export.
lib.recovery.close_tip: Close this window. A quarantine already started continues in its worker; closing does not undo it.
lib.recovery.partial: Quarantine is incomplete. Preserved plan and moved bytes: {folder}. Inspect again to review remaining resources.
lib.recovery.done: Resources preserved in {folder}. Inspect again before another recovery.
lib.recovery.clean: No interrupted export lock found. Unclaimed resources are not inspected or moved.
lib.recovery.ready: Review all {count} listed resources before choosing quarantine.
lib.recovery.error.sidecar_export_busy: Another export or recovery is active; try again later.
lib.recovery.error.invalid_export_guard: The export guard requires manual review; it was preserved.
lib.recovery.error.unverifiable_export_l: Ownership cannot be verified; the resources were preserved for manual review.
lib.recovery.error.unsafe_recovery_resou: A resource is a link or is not a regular file; review it manually.
lib.recovery.error.recovery_identity_cha: The temporary file identity changed; review it manually.
lib.recovery.error.recovery_changed: The resources changed since inspection. Inspect again before choosing quarantine.
lib.recovery.error.recovery_cancelled: Recovery was cancelled before it started.
gallery.viewer.version_history: This path has offline history; review the specific copy version before editing
gallery.viewer.copy_changed: The registered copy changed; reload it before editing
lib.review.state.offline_history: Offline history — review the copy version
lib.review.error.version_identity_requir: This path has offline history; review its specific copy version
lib.review.error.offline_version_require: This is an offline version; review it in the offline catalog
lib.versions.title: Copy versions and offline catalog
lib.versions.note: Offline records keep their identity and curation. Archive only changes the catalog. Verify the file to activate the same known content; different or unknown content creates a separate version with empty curation. These actions never change image bytes or Cherry download history.
lib.versions.scope_tip: Include active copies to archive them explicitly or verify a replaced file.
lib.versions.table_tip: Select a specific copy ID to read its complete stored state before accepting an action.
lib.versions.details_tip: Complete stored fields, tags, sources and categories for the selected ID; nothing is truncated. Records exceeding the review limits require separate review.
lib.versions.action_failed: Copy {id} was not confirmed: {reason}. Read its current state before retrying.
lib.versions.restart_tip: Read current records from the first page.
lib.versions.next_tip: Read up to 100 more versions without retaining previous pages.
lib.versions.archive_tip: Hide this copy from operational views; retain all stored data and file bytes.
lib.versions.online_tip: Hash the current file in a worker. Matching content restores this identity; different content starts a new clean version.
lib.versions.close_tip: Cancel verification before admission. A database action already accepted continues after closing.
lib.versions.open_tip: Review stored copies by ID, preserve an active copy offline or verify a file before making it available.
lib.versions.error.copy_version_changed_: Stored identity or curation changed; review the current state.
lib.versions.error.copy_version_path_occ: Another active copy already occupies this path; review it before archiving it.
lib.versions.error.copy_version_payload_: This record exceeds the review limits; all stored data was preserved.
lib.versions.error.unsupported_copy_vers: This record contains data requiring separate review; it was preserved.
lib.versions.error.copy_version_missing: This copy ID is no longer present; restart the catalog.
lib.versions.error.copy_version_file_cha: The file changed during hashing; verify it again.
lib.versions.error.copy_version_file_sym: This file is a symbolic link and requires separate review.
lib.versions.error.copy_version_file_not: This path is not a regular file.
lib.versions.error.copy_version_path_not: A relative stored path requires separate review.
lib.versions.error.copy_version_commit_u: The database did not confirm the action.
lib.versions.error.queue_full: The write queue is full; try again later.
dup.recovery_tip: Persistent destination outside all source folders, watched roots and Cherry projects, on the same volume as the moved copies. Files and recovery journals are preserved here.
dup.policy_note: Documented copies take priority. Conflicts, unknown identities and external captions or sidecars require review. Visual similarity does not authorize retirement.
dup.details_tip: Complete captured copy state: tags, sources, categories, rating and metadata. Select a group to review all its copies.
dup.cancel_tip: Cancels reads and unadmitted work without blocking the interface. Accepted index, retirement or pHash batches finish and are retained; only confirmed pHash writes count as stored.
dup.cancelled: Scan cancelled. No files were changed.
dup.retiring: Rechecking exact copies and preparing recoverable retirement…
dup.rescan_required: Options changed. Scan again before retiring files.
dup.weight_tip: Weight for comparing documented copies. Curation always comes first; conflicting or complementary information prevents retirement.
dup.retirement_failed: Retirement was not confirmed: {reason}. Scan again before retrying.
dup.retirement_summary: Recovered {count} copies. Read the results and journals before retrying.
dup.visual_review_only: Visual groups are for review only. Use exact content to retire copies.
dup.incomplete: Review incomplete: {count} issues. Retirement is disabled.
dup.scan_summary: {groups} groups, {copies} copies. Documented copies take priority.
dup.choose_recovery_tip: Choose a persistent folder outside all source folders, watched roots and Cherry projects, on the volume of the copies to move.
dup.previous_tip: Show the previous 100 copies. Selections from other pages are retained.
dup.next_tip: Show the next 100 copies. Selections from other pages are retained.
dup.reason_complete_information_preserve: The retained copy contains all documented information.
dup.reason_complementary_or_conflicting_: Complementary or conflicting information: preserve all copies for review.
dup.reason_external_documentation_requir: External captions or sidecars require review; keep the copies.
dup.reason_copy_not_registered: No central copy identity is known; review before retirement.
dup.reason_copy_not_active: The copy is offline or its identity changed.
dup.reason_catalog_identity_mismatch: Current bytes differ from the catalog identity; verify copy versions.
dup.reason_current_bytes_unverified: Current file bytes could not be verified.
dup.reason_ambiguous_path_identity: Path aliases or hard links require separate review.
dup.reason_central_snapshot_failed: The central documented state could not be read.
dup.reason_state_unreviewable: The complete stored state requires separate review.
dup.reason_duplicate_group_limit: This group exceeds the review limit; keep every copy.
dup.reason_duplicate_review_inventory_li: More than 100,000 supported files: choose a smaller folder.
dup.reason_duplicate_review_group_limit: Too many duplicate groups: choose a smaller folder.
dup.reason_duplicate_review_copy_limit: More than 2,000 duplicate copies: choose a smaller folder.
dup.reason_duplicate_review_payload_limi: Documented states exceed the review budget; review a smaller scope.
dup.reason_duplicate_review_folder_unava: The folder is unavailable or linked.
dup.reason_duplicate_review_data_service: The central library service is unavailable.
dup.reason_duplicate_group_changed_since: A copy identity or its curation changed; scan again.
dup.reason_duplicate_bytes_changed_since: A file changed since review; no retirement was admitted.
dup.reason_duplicate_bytes_changed_after: A file changed after catalog archival; bytes were preserved for recovery.
dup.reason_duplicate_recovery_requires_s: Choose a recovery folder on the same volume as the copies.
dup.reason_duplicate_recovery_inside_col: The recovery folder must be outside the scanned collection.
dup.reason_duplicate_recovery_inside_che: The recovery folder must be outside the Cherry project.
dup.reason_duplicate_retirement_linked_p: Linked source or recovery paths require separate review.
dup.reason_duplicate_recovery_destinatio: The recovery destination is occupied; existing bytes were preserved.
dup.reason_duplicate_recovered_bytes_req: Recovered bytes require review; they were preserved with the journal.
dup.reason_duplicate_retirement_commit_u: The database did not confirm archival; no files were moved.
dup.reason_duplicate_archive_selection_n: This selection does not preserve all known information; review the group.
dup.reason_duplicate_retirement_requires: Recoverable retirement is supported on Windows; scanning remains available.
dup.reason_visual_similarity_requires_ex: Visual similarity is not proof of identical content; keep copies for review.
dup.reason_duplicate_visual_inventory_li: Visual review supports up to 2,000 images; choose a smaller folder.
dup.reason_duplicate_visual_pixel_limit: This image exceeds the visual pixel budget; it was preserved.
dup.reason_service_closed: The central database service is closed.
dup.reason_queue_full: The central write queue is full; retry later.
dup.reason_duplicate_recovery_inside_lib: Choose recovery outside every watched library folder.
dup.reason_duplicate_retirement_scope_li: Watched folders exceed the bounded recovery-scope review; review them separately.
dup.reason_duplicate_retirement_scope_ch: Watched folders changed during preparation; scan and review the destination again.
dup.reason_duplicate_retirement_scope_re: A stored watched folder path requires separate review.
dup.recovery_required: Choose an absolute persistent recovery folder before retirement.
dup.retirement_partial: Retirement incomplete: {count} copies moved. {reason} Review the catalog and recovery journals before retrying.
dup.gallery_group_limit: Gallery handoff requires 1 to 1,000 images in the complete group. No images were sent.
dup.open_group_tip: Inspect every image of the selected group in Gallery, without changing the duplicate review or selecting retirement. Complete groups are limited to 1,000 images.
dup.db_status_unknown: Search index status has not been checked.
dup.db_tree_tip: Select a stored-hash group for physical verification. Counts include all active native copies across folders; no subset is approved.
dup.db_prepare_tip: Explicitly builds or reuses the compatible partial index without changing copy identities or curation. Other writes wait during construction, limited to 30 seconds; timeout rolls back.
dup.db_previous_tip: Read the previous page of up to 25 candidate groups. Changing pages clears the verified group and its retirement selection.
dup.db_next_tip: Read the next page of up to 25 stored-hash groups. Pages reflect current catalog state, not a frozen library snapshot.
dup.db_verify_tip: Hash the current bytes and inspect the complete native curation of every member, up to 256 copies. Missing files or changed identities block retirement; verification changes nothing.
dup.db_search_tip: Read a page of active stored-hash candidates across folders. This reads no images and changes no records; select a complete group for physical verification.
dup.db_working: Reading the native catalog or finishing index preparation…
dup.db_ready: Search index prepared. Find candidates, then verify a complete group.
dup.db_unprepared: Search index is not prepared. Candidate reads are available; global retirement requires preparation.
dup.db_hash_tip: Stored hashes only propose candidates. They never authorize retirement.
dup.db_page: Candidate page {page}: {groups} groups. Select one and verify its current bytes and curation.
dup.reason_duplicate_search_not_prepared: Prepare the native search index before retiring a global group.
dup.reason_duplicate_index_name_conflict: An incompatible index already uses this name; review it without replacing it.
dup.reason_duplicate_index_build_budget_: Index construction exceeded its time budget and was rolled back.
dup.reason_duplicate_index_prepare_uncon: Index preparation was not confirmed by the database owner.
dup.reason_duplicate_discovery_budget_ex: Candidate discovery exceeded its read budget; prepare the index or narrow the work.
dup.reason_duplicate_candidate_group_cha: The complete group changed; find and verify it again.
dup.reason_duplicate_candidate_group_mis: This group no longer has at least two active copies.
dup.reason_duplicate_group_requires_sepa: Groups larger than 256 copies require separate review; no subset is approved.
dup.reason_duplicate_candidates_payload_: Candidate data exceeds the review budget; review it separately.
dup.reason_unsupported_duplicate_candida: A candidate path requires separate review.
dup.reason_invalid_duplicate_archive_sco: The retirement scope is invalid; verify the complete group again.
dup.overlap_run_tip: Compare all pairs of selected folders by stored unique hashes and show coverage. No image reads, merges or retirement occur.
dup.overlap_working: Comparing stored hash sets and classifying folder pairs…
dup.overlap_summary: {folders} folders, {pairs} classified pairs. Stored hashes only; inspect coverage before acting.
dup.overlap_note: Compare 2–32 separate indexed folders, one per line. Stored hashes classify pairs for review only; they do not authorize merges or retirement.
dup.overlap_folders_placeholder: Absolute folder paths, one per line
dup.overlap_folders_tip: Paste absolute indexed folder paths or add them with the picker. Nested or repeated scopes are rejected. Counts exclude offline copies and show unknown hashes separately.
dup.overlap_add_tip: Append an existing folder to the comparison scope. Only native indexed records are counted; no indexing or hashing starts.
dup.overlap_clear_tip: Clear the comparison scope and its report without changing the library or files.
dup.overlap_threshold_tip: Classify a nonempty shared pair as high overlap when shared unique hashes / union reaches this percentage. Directional coverage is shown separately; no automatic merge follows.
dup.overlap_tree_tip: Select a pair to inspect both folders’ hash coverage and directional containment. The report uses stored identities, not current physical bytes or curation.
dup.overlap_details_tip: Complete captured coverage: active copies, known and unknown hashes, unique hashes, shared/union counts and directional ratios. It is a read-only report.
dup.reason_invalid_folder_overlap_scope: Choose 2–32 absolute indexed folders, each path up to 4,096 characters.
dup.reason_folder_overlap_nested_scope: Choose separate scopes: equal or nested folders would inflate overlap.
dup.reason_invalid_folder_overlap_thresh: Choose a Jaccard threshold from 0 to 100 percent.
dup.reason_folder_overlap_copy_budget_ex: Selected scopes exceed 250,000 active copies. Compare a smaller complete batch; no partial report was published.
dup.reason_folder_overlap_payload_budget: The complete report exceeds its size budget; compare fewer scopes.
dup.overlap_folder_details:
Folder {label}: {folder}
Active copies: {active} · Hashed: {known} · Unknown: {unknown} · Unique hashes: {unique}
dup.phash_working: Verifying current bytes and preparing persistent pHash…
dup.phash_run_tip: Run the separate explicit CPU phase on these folders. Checks bytes and saves derived evidence in batches; does not change curation, Cherry catalogs or images.
dup.phash_scope_changed: Choose the explicit scope and run the pHash phase. Previous accepted batches remain stored.
dup.phash_service_required: The native library service is required to store pHash.
dup.phash_summary: Stored: {stored} · Reused: {reused} · Issues: {issues}. Confirmed batches are preserved.
dup.phash_cancelled: pHash phase cancelled; accepted writes completed.
dup.phash_partial: pHash phase has pending issues. Inspect the result before retrying.
dup.phash_note: Explicit phase for 1–32 separate indexed folders, one per line. Checks current SHA and saves derived pHash in the native database; preserves curation and Cherry receipts. Similarity never authorizes retirement.
dup.phash_folders_placeholder: Absolute indexed folder paths, one per line
dup.phash_folders_tip: Choose only the indexed folders to process. Unknown SHA values require the separate SHA phase; mismatched bytes are reported without storing ambiguous pHash.
dup.phash_add_tip: Append a folder to the explicit scope. Calculation starts only when you press Calculate and save pHash.
dup.phash_clear_tip: Clear the selected scope and displayed result; previously committed derived hashes remain in the database.
dup.phash_pixels_tip: Maximum decoded pixels per image, up to 10 million. Larger images are preserved and reported. Verified cache reuse skips decoding but still reads current SHA.
dup.phash_images_tip: Maximum images with known SHA in this run, up to 100,000. An initial excess rejects the whole scope before preparation; later failures retain only confirmed batches.
dup.phash_details_tip: Confirmed stored and reused counts, unknown SHA values and at most 20 sampled issues. Cancelling keeps accepted commits; counts never claim unconfirmed writes.
dup.reason_phash_registry_name_conflict: A foreign or incompatible registry uses this name; review it without replacement.
dup.reason_phash_registry_not_prepared: Explicitly prepare the pHash registry before storing derived evidence.
dup.reason_phash_registry_prepare_unconf: Registry preparation was not confirmed by the database owner.
dup.reason_phash_batch_commit_unconfirme: The pHash batch was not confirmed; it is excluded from stored counts.
dup.reason_phash_copy_identity_changed: A copy ID, path or current SHA changed; the entire batch was rejected.
dup.reason_phash_backfill_image_budget: The scope exceeds the chosen image budget; select a smaller complete scope.
dup.reason_phash_source_sha_unknown: Calculate SHA-256 in its separate phase before persisting pHash for these images.
dup.reason_phash_inventory_changed: The indexed inventory changed during this pass; review counts before retrying.
dup.reason_phash_state_identity_changed: The complete cached state changed or was truncated; no partial group was approved.
dup.reason_phash_state_requires_review: The derived state is invalid and requires review.
dup.reason_phash_page_requires_review: The complete native pHash page requires review.
dup.reason_phash_page_payload_limit: Derived data exceeds its size budget; no partial page was published.
dup.reason_invalid_library_folder_scope: Choose 1–32 absolute indexed folder paths, up to 4,096 characters each.
dup.reason_nested_library_folder_scope: Choose separate folder scopes, without repeated or nested paths.
dup.reason_phash_backfill_failed: The pHash phase failed; review confirmed counts before retrying.
dup.recovery_review_working: Checking journal, native identities and both file locations…
dup.recovery_review_run_tip: Inspect one complete retirement journal against current native identity, curation and file bytes outside the GUI thread. No writes, restore or purge occur.
dup.recovery_review_changed: Choose a journal and request a fresh review. No changes are made automatically.
dup.recovery_review_service_required: The native library service is required to review IDs and curation.
dup.recovery_review_cancelled: Journal review cancelled. No changes were made.
dup.recovery_review_summary: Journal reviewed: {verified} verified retirements · {pending} requiring review. No changes were made.
dup.recovery_review_note: Select one retirement journal explicitly. Compares native IDs, curation and current bytes at both locations. Recorded phase is not proof of completion. This review changes nothing and does not restore or purge.
dup.recovery_review_path_tip: Paste the journal path shown after retirement. One complete group is reviewed; changing the path discards the displayed evidence and never starts work automatically.
dup.recovery_review_choose_tip: Select an existing journal.json. Verification starts only when you press Review recovery journal. Files and portable Cherry databases remain untouched.
dup.recovery_review_tree_tip: Select a copy to inspect its original and recovery paths, native ID, current occupant and documentation. Equal SHA with different file identity remains pending review.
dup.recovery_review_details_tip: Evidence reflects this inspection only. Missing paths are distinguished from unavailable parents; any future restore or purge requires a fresh check and an explicit action.
dup.recovery_review_select: Select a copy to inspect the observed evidence.
dup.reason_invalid_duplicate_recovery_jo: The journal format, identity or contained destination requires manual review.
dup.reason_duplicate_recovery_journal_li: The journal exceeds the safe read limit of 5 MiB.
dup.reason_duplicate_recovery_journal_ch: The journal changed during inspection. Request a fresh review.
dup.reason_duplicate_recovery_native_inc: Native IDs could not be reviewed as a complete group. No evidence was published.
dup.reason_duplicate_recovery_report_lim: The complete evidence exceeds the report limit; manual review is required.
dup.reason_duplicate_recovery_journal_un: The journal could not be read. Check the selected path and disk access.
dup.reason_invalid_duplicate_recovery_id: Choose a complete group of at most 256 distinct native IDs.
